parameter.name: serialPort
parameter.label: Serial Port
parameter.description: Serial port to use for connecting to the Oppo player.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Address
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the Oppo player or machine used for serial over IP.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: (Optional) Communication port for serial over IP connection. Leave blank if connecting directly to the player.

parameter.name: verboseMode
parameter.label: Verbose Mode
parameter.description: If true, the player will send time updates every second. If false, the binding polls the player every 10 seconds
